This is great!

One question I’d like to see is…

Do you intend to buy TEC tokens with the funds that you you are getting from this proposal.

People that are willing to hold their reward in TEC tokens will be able to vote for their own future proposals so this is signal that the recipient wants to be a long term member of this org.

There is also a huge benefit for the economy for the funding pool funds to be redeposited into the bonding curve.

Also, there is the fact that when they put money into the TEC, they have to pay the exit tribute… but I think it makes sense for someone to say they are asking for “1200 xdai 1000 xdai for the project and 200 xdai for the exit tribute” (assuming the exit tribute is 20%)

Also I think we can also look at some proposals from 1hive to see how we feel about the template.

https://forum.1hive.org/t/bootstrapping-the-1hive-gardens-swarm-dao/1159 (our proposal for the Gardens Swarm)
